description: GEOX Biostratigraphy MCP Prompt Manifest. 4 prompts for repeatable, structured biostratigraphic reasoning by MCP agents. Prompts are reusable reasoning templates — they encode the discipline, not the data.

interpret_claim.name: interpret_claim
interpret_claim.description: Interpret a biostratigraphic claim through the 4-layer model: observation → taxonomy → bioevent → geological interpretation. Separate what was seen from what was inferred.
goals: Parse free-text biostrat claim into structured observations
Identify fossil group, biozone, and claimed age/environment
Label each element with truth class (OBSERVATION_BIOLOGICAL, INTERPRETATION_STRATIGRAPHIC, etc.)
Flag any collapsed claims (e.g. fossil name → age without calibration)
interpret_claim.template:
Given the biostratigraphic claim: {claim}

1. OBSERVE: Extract all fossil observations, zones, taxa, and sample data.
2. CLASSIFY: Assign truth classes: OBSERVATION_BIOLOGICAL | INTERPRETATION_STRATIGRAPHIC | CALIBRATED_CHRONOSTRAT_CONSTRAINT | MODEL_HYPOTHESIS | CLAIM_EXPLORATION.
3. SEPARATE: Identify where the claim collapses layers (e.g. fossil directly to age without calibration).
4. WARN: Flag any over-precision, missing calibration, or unstated assumptions.

Output: structured interpretation with truth-class labels and separation warnings.

challenge_age_pick.name: challenge_age_pick
challenge_age_pick.description: Challenge a numeric age claim derived from biostratigraphy. Test every assumption: calibration table, taxonomic ID, preservation, facies compatibility, regional applicability.
goals: Identify the fossil basis for the age claim
Verify calibration table and version
Check facies compatibility (does the fossil ecology match the lithology?)
Test for reworking, caving, or contamination
Check regional applicability (was this calibrated here or imported?)

check_facies_conflict.name: check_facies_conflict
check_facies_conflict.description: Check whether a fossil assemblage is physically compatible with its host lithology and depositional environment. Marine fossils in coal → FALSIFIED. Freshwater algae in deep marine → transported.
goals: Map fossil ecology requirements (marine water, freshwater, brackish)
Map lithology to canonical class (COAL_CARBONACEOUS, SHALE_PRONE, etc.)
Map depositional environment to canonical class (freshwater_swamp, marine_shelf, etc.)
Test compatibility using facies veto matrix
If contradiction: suggest rescue hypotheses (reworking, thin marine incursion, facies misidentification)

build_well_ruling.name: build_well_ruling
build_well_ruling.description: Build a complete, uncertainty-bearing biostratigraphic ruling for a single well. Integrate all fossil observations, facies checks, stratigraphic order, and regional context into a single governed verdict.
goals: Compile all biostrat observations from the well
Resolve each biozone to calibrated age
Check facies compatibility for each fossil-bearing interval
Verify stratigraphic ordering (younger above older)
Detect unconformities (missing zones, abrupt facies shift)
Cross-check with seismic group and regional framework
Emit final ruling with confidence tier and required next evidence

constitutional_alignment.Δ_CLARITY: Prompts enforce explicit separation of observation, interpretation, model, and claim
constitutional_alignment.Ω_HUMILITY: Every prompt output requires confidence tier and uncertainty band
constitutional_alignment.Ψ_VITALITY: Prompts surface contradictions, never suppress them
